name: bld3_edelstein_iInter_range_iterate
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) (p : X) (hp : f p = p) : ⋂ n : ℕ, Set.range (f^[n]) = {p}
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) (p : X) (hp : f p = p), ⋂ n : ℕ, Set.range (f^[n]) = {p}
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_edelstein_iterates_tendsto and Mathlib2.bld2_edelstein_no_periodic_points: p is in every range since f^[n] p = p; conversely if y = f^[n] (x_n) for all n, uniform convergence of the iterates to p (Dini applied to the monotone pointwise convergence from the library) gives dist y p < ε for every ε.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X), (∀ (x y : X), x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) → ∀ (p : X), f p = p → ⋂ n, Set.range f^[n] = {p}
